reviews.title: Awesome fans
reviews.comment: Amazing fans. Not to loud and they work great and are easy to set up! I use 6 of these bad boys with my liquid cooling set up and my PC never gets over 59 degrees Celsius. Cable management is easy, just make it look pretty. Airflow is amazing as well so it’s a great investment.
reviews.author: brandon

reviews.title: Good product, needed to tinker in BIOS to lower fan speed
reviews.comment: Purchased the three pack of fans.  Package included: - 12 mounting screws, enough for all 3 fans - 2 extension cords to allow you to connect fans to the mother board. - 3 fans, each having a male/female connection cords to allow you to daisy chain the fans.  The length of cable to the female connection is very short, and will likely not connect to the motherboard on its own without an extension cord, but has enough room to daisy chain to another fan.  So with only being given 2 extension cords, at least 2 of the fans will need to be daisy chained together without buying additional cables. Installation was easy, dimensions were as advertised. Airflow is very good.  In my set-up the fans defaulted to maximum speed and I had to tinker in my BIOS to lower the fan speed.  At maximum speed, there was a noticeably loud humming noise that couldn't be corrected.  At lower fan speeds, the humming noise stopped and fan noise was quiet.
reviews.author: Lars

reviews.title: Works as intended.
reviews.comment: I have no clue on how to properly install anything in pc, but thank god for Gemini and ChatGPT. I bought the fan and they walked me through on how to install it. Before anything I recommend cleaning out the computer, but after that, these fans start zooming. They are quiet but, they can reach a high rpm. Great quality too. Solid. And the cable length was a little short for a full atx tower, but still good.
reviews.author: Andrew S

reviews.title: perfectly standard.
reviews.comment: they're good fans. not perfectly silent when running high but the noise is smooth and easy to tune out. they're just your typical 120mm fans, they'll do what you expect them to and mount in wherever you would want a 120mm fan to go. they won't last forever but they probably will go for at least 3-4 years before the bearings give out so i would say it's worth the price. no LEDs is just perfect- subtle and undistracting.
reviews.author: Drew Seiler

reviews.title: Similar to Noctua NF-14a
reviews.comment: Quiet and good performance fan. Perhaps quieter than the NF-14a fans already in my case. Major downside here is price point, but for the money I’d say it’s worth it.
